 101class PdQtAnnotator(QMainWindow, UiMainWindow):
 102    """
 103    Qt_Annotator_Window is a GUI class for annotating PD curves.
 104
 105    The annotator works with PD curves and allows
 106    selection of a single points (labelled as pdOnset in the saved file).
 107    The GUI also displays the waveform, and if TextGrids
 108    are provided, the acoustic segment boundaries.
 109    """
 110
 111    default_categories = ['Stable', 'Hesitation', 'Chaos', 'No data',
 112                          'Not set']
 113
 114    default_tongue_positions = ['High', 'Low', 'Other / Not visible']

 300    def _update_color_mode(self) -> None:
 301        match self.gui_config.color_scheme:
 302            case GuiColorScheme.DARK:
 303                self.change_to_dark()
 304            case GuiColorScheme.LIGHT:
 305                self.change_to_light()
 306            case GuiColorScheme.FOLLOW_SYSTEM:
 307                match QGuiApplication.styleHints().colorScheme():
 308                    case Qt.ColorScheme.Dark:
 309                        self.gui_config.color_scheme = GuiColorScheme.DARK
 310                        self.change_to_dark()
 311                    case Qt.ColorScheme.Light:
 312                        self.gui_config.color_scheme = GuiColorScheme.LIGHT
 313                        self.change_to_light()
 314                    case _:
 315                        self.gui_config.color_scheme = GuiColorScheme.DARK
 316                        self.change_to_dark()
 317                        _logger.warning(
 318                            "Unknown system level color scheme. "
 319                            "So just setting mode to dark.")
 320            case _:
 321                _logger.warning(
 322                    "Unrecognised gui style %s.",
 323                    self.gui_config.color_scheme)
 324
 325    def _update_exercise_controls(self):
 326        if self.session.exercise is None:
 327            self.action_new_exercise.setEnabled(True)
 328            self.mode_drop_down.setCurrentText(AnnotatorMode.ANALYSE.value)
 329            self.mode_drop_down.setEnabled(False)
 330            self.action_new_answer.setEnabled(False)
 331            self.action_open_answer.setEnabled(False)
 332            self.action_show_example.setEnabled(False)
 333        else:
 334            self.action_new_exercise.setEnabled(False)
 335            self.mode_drop_down.setCurrentText(self.annotator_mode.value)
 336            self.mode_drop_down.setEnabled(True)
 337            self.action_new_answer.setEnabled(True)
 338            self.action_open_answer.setEnabled(True)
 339            self.action_show_example.setEnabled(True)

 355    @property
 356    def current(self):
 357        """Current recording at index."""
 358        return self.recordings[self.index]
 359
 360    @property
 361    def default_annotations(self):
 362        """List default annotations and their default values as a dict."""
 363        return {
 364            'pdCategory': self.categories[-1],
 365            'tonguePosition': self.tongue_positions[-1],
 366            'selected_time': -1.0,
 367            'selection_index': -1,
 368            'frame_selection_index': -1,
 369            'selected_frequency': -1,
 370        }
 371
 372    def _add_annotations(self):
 373        """Add the annotations."""
 374        for recording in self.recordings:
 375            if recording.annotations:
 376                recording.annotations = dict(
 377                    list(self.default_annotations.items()) +
 378                    list(recording.annotations.items()))
 379            else:
 380                recording.annotations = deepcopy(self.default_annotations)
 381
 382    def _get_title(self):
 383        """
 384        Private helper function for generating the title.
 385        """
 386        text = 'Recording: ' + str(self.index + 1) + '/' + str(self.max_index)
 387        text += ', prompt: ' + self.current.metadata.prompt
 388        return text
 389
 390    def _get_long_title(self):
 391        """
 392        Private helper function for generating a longer title for a figure.
 393        """
 394        text = ""
 395        if (
 396            self.session.exercise is not None and
 397            self.exercise_drop_down.isEnabled()
 398        ):
 399            text += "Exercise Mode -- "
 400            text += "Answer: " + self.session.exercise.current_answer.name
 401            text += " -- Showing " + self.exercise_drop_down.currentText()
 402            text += ' -- '
 403
 404        text += 'Recording: ' + str(self.index + 1) + '/' + str(self.max_index)
 405        if str(self.current.metadata.participant_id):
 406            text += ', Speaker: ' + str(self.current.metadata.participant_id)
 407        if self.current.metadata.prompt:
 408            text += ', prompt: ' + self.current.metadata.prompt
 409        return text

 411    def _release_modality_memory(self):
 412        if 'RawUltrasound' in self.current.modalities:
 413            self.current.modalities['RawUltrasound'].data = None
 414
 415    def _set_audio_for_player(self) -> None:
 416        """Pass the current audio data to the audio player."""
 417        if 'MonoAudio' in self.current.modalities:
 418            mono_audio = self.current['MonoAudio'].modality_data
 419            self.audio_player.set_audio(
 420                audio_data=mono_audio.data,
 421                sampling_rate=mono_audio.sampling_rate
 422            )
 423
 424    def _sync_selected_time(self, current_position: float) -> None:
 425        """
 426        Sync the global annotation state with the audio player's position.
 427
 428        Parameters
 429        ----------
 430        current_position : float
 431            The time in seconds where playback was paused.
 432        """
 433        self.current.annotations['selected_time'] = current_position
 434        self.update()
 435
 436    def update(self) -> None:
 437        """Updates the graphs but not the buttons."""
 438        if (
 439            self.annotator_mode is AnnotatorMode.EXERCISE and
 440            self.exercise_mode is ExerciseMode.ANSWER
 441        ):
 442            self.patgrid = self.session.exercise.current_answer[self.index]
 443        else:
 444            self.patgrid = self.current.patgrid
 445
 446        self.plot_controller.draw_plots(
 447            recording=self.current,
 448            patgrid=self.patgrid,
 449            xlim=self.xlim,
 450            mode=self.annotator_mode,
 451            exercise_mode=self.exercise_mode,
 452            title=self._get_long_title(),
 453        )
 454        self.plot_controller.update_multicursor()
 455        self.plot_controller.canvas.draw_idle()
 456
 457        if self.display_tongue:
 458            _logger.debug("Drawing ultra frame in update")
 459            has_ultra_data = self.plot_controller.draw_ultra_frame(
 460                recording=self.current,
 461                image_type=self.image_type
 462            )
 463            self.plot_controller.ultra_canvas.draw_idle()
 464            self.action_export_ultrasound_frame.setEnabled(has_ultra_data)
 465

 494    def next(self):
 495        """
 496        Callback function for the Next button.
 497        Increases cursor index, updates the view.
 498        """
 499        if self.index < self.max_index - 1:
 500            self._release_modality_memory()
 501            self.index += 1
 502            self._set_audio_for_player()
 503            self.update()
 504            self.update_ui()
 505            if self.session.exercise is not None:
 506                self.session.exercise.current_answer.next()
 507
 508    def prev(self):
 509        """
 510        Callback function for the Previous button.
 511        Decreases cursor index, updates the view.
 512        """
 513        if self.index > 0:
 514            self._release_modality_memory()
 515            self.index -= 1
 516            self._set_audio_for_player()
 517            self.update()
 518            self.update_ui()
 519            if self.session.exercise is not None:
 520                self.session.exercise.current_answer.previous()
 521
 522    def go_to_recording(self, index: int):
 523        """
 524        Move to recording at index.
 525
 526        Parameters
 527        ----------
 528        index : int
 529            Index of recording to move to.
 530        """
 531        self._release_modality_memory()
 532        self.index = index
 533        self._set_audio_for_player()
 534        self.update()
 535        self.update_ui()
 536        if self.session.exercise is not None:
 537            self.session.exercise.current_answer.go_to_recording(index=index)

 539    def go_to_callback(self):
 540        """
 541        Go to a recording specified in the goLineEdit text input field.
 542        """
 543        index_to_jump_to = int(self.go_to_line_edit.text()) - 1
 544
 545        if 0 <= index_to_jump_to < len(self.session):
 546            self.go_to_recording(index=index_to_jump_to)
 547
 548    def _update_pd_onset(self):
 549        audio = self.current.modalities['MonoAudio']
 550        if audio.go_signal is None:
 551            stimulus_onset = 0
 552        else:
 553            stimulus_onset = audio.go_signal
 554
 555        # TODO 0.24: This should not be hard coded
 556        if 'PD l1 on RawUltrasound' in self.current.modalities:
 557            pd_metrics = self.current.modalities['PD l1 on RawUltrasound']
 558            ultra_time = pd_metrics.timevector - stimulus_onset
 559            index = self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index']
 560            self.current.annotations['selected_time'] = ultra_time[index]
 561
 562    def next_frame(self):
 563        """
 564        Move the data cursor to the next frame.
 565        """
 566        # TODO 0.24: Remove hard coding again
 567        if 'PD l1 on RawUltrasound' not in self.current.modalities:
 568            return
 569
 570        frame_selection_index = self.current.annotations[
 571            'frame_selection_index']
 572        pd = self.current.modalities['PD l1 on RawUltrasound']
 573        data_length = pd.data.size
 574        if -1 < frame_selection_index < data_length:
 575            self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'] += 1
 576            _logger.debug(
 577                "next frame: %d",
 578                (self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index']))
 579            self._update_pd_onset()
 580            self.update()
 581            self.update_ui()
 582
 583    def previous_frame(self):
 584        """
 585        Move the data cursor to the previous frame.
 586        """
 587        if self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'] > 0:
 588            self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'] -= 1
 589            _logger.debug(
 590                "previous frame: %d",
 591                (self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index']))
 592            self._update_pd_onset()

 629    def open(self):
 630        """
 631        Open either patkit saved data or import new data.
 632        """
 633        directory_name = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
 634            self, caption="Open directory", directory='.'
 635        )
 636        if not directory_name:
 637            return  # User cancelled the dialog
 638
 639        target_path = Path(directory_name)
 640
 641        # TODO 0.24: this should be made into a proper option, now it's just
 642        # set at in run_annotator below
 643        # self.display_tongue = display_tongue
 644
 645        path_type, target_path = resolve_open_path(target_path)
 646
 647        match path_type:
 648            case OpenPathType.MANIFEST:
 649                scenarios = get_manifest_scenarios(path=target_path)
 650                if not scenarios:
 651                    raise ValueError("Manifest file is empty or invalid.")
 652                elif len(scenarios) == 1:
 653                    target_path = scenarios[0]
 654                else:
 655                    # Prompt the user to choose if multiple exist
 656                    scenario_strings = [str(p) for p in scenarios]
 657                    chosen_string, ok_pressed = ListSelectionDialog.get_item(
 658                        parent=self,
 659                        title="Select Scenario",
 660                        label="Multiple scenarios found. Select one:",
 661                        items=scenario_strings,
 662                        current=0,
 663                    )
 664                    if ok_pressed and chosen_string:
 665                        target_path = Path(chosen_string)
 666                    else:
 667                        return  # User cancelled the prompt
 668            case OpenPathType.SCENARIO:
 669                pass
 670            case OpenPathType.DIRECTORY:
 671                raise NotImplementedError(
 672                    "Opening a directory of data without "
 673                    "config is not implemented yet."
 674                )
 675            case OpenPathType.SINGLE_DATA:
 676                raise NotImplementedError(
 677                    "Opening a single data file without "
 678                    "config is not implemented yet."
 679                )
 680            case _:
 681                raise NotImplementedError(
 682                    f"Unknown path type {path_type}."
 683                )
 684
 685        # Read config and data
 686        config, logger = initialise_config(
 687            path=target_path, require_gui=True
 688        )
 689        self.session = initialise_patkit(config=config, logger=logger)
 690
 691        # Re-bind Configuration Properties
 692        self.config = config  # Update the annotator's config reference
 693        self.data_config = config.data_config
 694        self.gui_config = config.gui_config
 695        self.gui_color_mode = self.gui_config.color_scheme
 696        self._update_color_mode()
 697
 698        # Reset Core State Variables
 699        self.recordings = self.session.recordings
 700        self.index = 0
 701        self.max_index = len(self.recordings)
 702        self.patgrid = self.current.patgrid  # self.current uses self.index
 703
 704        # Update Validators and Database View
 705        go_validator = QIntValidator(1, self.max_index + 1, self)
 706        self.go_to_line_edit.setValidator(go_validator)
 707        self.replace_items_in_database_view(session=self.session)
 708        self._add_annotations()
 709
 710        self.update()
 711        # In case labels change as new plots are drawn.
 712        self.figure.align_ylabels()
 713        self.update_ui()
 714

 779    def new_exercise(self) -> bool:
 780        """Create a new exercise based on the current Session."""
 781        scrambling_method = NewExerciseDialog.get_exercise_params(
 782            parent=self,
 783            path=self.session.patkit_path)
 784        if scrambling_method is None:
 785            return False
 786
 787        file_info = FileInformation(
 788            patkit_path=self.session.patkit_path / PatkitDirectory.EXERCISE
 789        )
 790        metadata = ExerciseMetadata(
 791            scrambling_method=ExerciseScrambler(scrambling_method),
 792        )
 793        self.session.exercise = Exercise(
 794            scenario=self.session,
 795            name=str(PatkitDirectory.EXERCISE),
 796            metadata=metadata,
 797            file_info=file_info,
 798        )
 799        if not self.new_answer():
 800            self.session.exercise = None
 801            return False
 802
 803        self.save_exercise()
 804        self.annotator_mode = AnnotatorMode.EXERCISE
 805        self._update_exercise_controls()
 806        return True
 807

 812    def new_answer(self) -> bool:
 813        """Create a new blank answer for the current exercise."""
 814        answer_name, author_name = NewAnswerDialog.get_answer_params(self)
 815        if answer_name is None:
 816            return False
 817
 818        self.session.exercise.new_blank_answer(
 819            name=answer_name, author=author_name)
 820
 821        # Move cursor to newly generated answer (always at the end)
 822        self.session.exercise.cursor = len(self.session.exercise) - 1
 823        self.save_answer()
 824
 825        self.annotator_mode = AnnotatorMode.EXERCISE
 826        self._update_exercise_controls()
 827        self.update()
 828        return True

 834    def open_answer(self) -> None:
 835        """Load an Answer and open it in the GUI."""
 836        answers_dir = (
 837            self.session.exercise.patkit_path / PatkitDirectory.ANSWERS
 838        )
 839
 840        available_answers = [
 841            d.name for d in answers_dir.iterdir() if d.is_dir()
 842        ]
 843        available_answers.sort()
 844
 845        answer_name, ok = QInputDialog.getItem(
 846            self,
 847            "Open Answer",
 848            "Select answer to open:",
 849            available_answers,
 850            0,
 851            False
 852        )
 853
 854        if not ok or not answer_name:
 855            return
 856
 857        # TODO 0.22.3: The loading here might be redundant, if Exercise already
 858        # front loads every answer.
 859        directory = answers_dir / answer_name
 860        answer = load_answer(
 861            answer_dir=directory, exercise=self.session.exercise
 862        )
 863        self.session.exercise[answer.name] = answer
 864
 865        self.session.exercise.cursor = list(
 866            self.session.exercise.keys()).index(answer.name)
 867        self.annotator_mode = AnnotatorMode.EXERCISE
 868        self._update_exercise_controls()
 869        self.go_to_recording(self.session.exercise.current_answer.cursor)

 933    def mode_selection_changed(self, mode: str) -> None:
 934        """
 935        Callback for changing annotator mode.
 936
 937        Parameters
 938        ----------
 939        mode : str
 940            The mode's name as a string.
 941
 942        Raises
 943        ------
 944        ValueError
 945            If encountering an unimplemented mode an Error will be raised.
 946        """
 947        self.annotator_mode = AnnotatorMode(mode)
 948        match self.annotator_mode:
 949            case AnnotatorMode.ANALYSE:
 950                self.to_annotator_mode()
 951            case AnnotatorMode.EXERCISE:
 952                self.to_exercise_mode()
 953            case _:
 954                raise ValueError(f"Unknown Annotator Mode requested: {mode}.")
 955

 960        Parameters
 961        ----------

 963            The mode's name as a string.
 964
 965        Raises
 966        ------
 967        ValueError
 968            If encountering an unimplemented mode an Error will be raised.
 969        """
 970        self.exercise_mode = ExerciseMode(mode)
 971        match self.exercise_mode:
 972            case ExerciseMode.EXAMPLE:
 973                self.to_example_mode()
 974            case ExerciseMode.ANSWER:
 975                self.to_answer_mode()
 976            case _:
 977                raise ValueError(f"Unknown Exercise Mode requested: {mode}.")

1101    def export_annotations_and_metadata(self) -> None:
1102        """
1103        Export annotations and some other meta data.
1104        """
1105        (filename, _) = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
1106            self, 'Save file', directory='.', filter="CSV files (*.csv)")
1107
1108        if not filename:
1109            return
1110
1111        vowels = ['a', 'A', 'e', 'E', 'i', 'I',
1112                  'o', 'O', 'u', '@', "@`", 'OI', 'V']
1113        fieldnames = ['basename', 'date_and_time', 'prompt', 'C1', 'C1_dur',
1114                      'word_dur', 'first_sound',
1115                      'first_sound_type', 'first_sound_dur', 'AAI']
1116        fieldnames.extend(self.default_annotations.keys())
1117        csv.register_dialect('tabseparated', delimiter='\t',
1118                             quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONE)
1119
1120        with closing(open(filename, 'w', encoding='utf-8')) as csvfile:
1121            writer = csv.DictWriter(csvfile, fieldnames, extrasaction='ignore',
1122                                    dialect='tabseparated')
1123
1124            writer.writeheader()
1125            for recording in self.recordings:
1126                annotations = recording.annotations.copy()
1127                annotations['basename'] = recording.basename
1128                annotations['date_and_time'] = (
1129                    recording.metadata.time_of_recording)
1130                annotations['prompt'] = recording.metadata.prompt
1131                annotations['word'] = recording.metadata.prompt.split()[0]
1132
1133                word_dur = -1.0
1134                acoustic_onset = -1.0
1135                if 'word' in recording.textgrid:
1136                    for interval in recording.textgrid['word']:
1137                        # change this to access the phonemeDict and
1138                        # check for included words, then search for
1139                        # phonemes based on the same
1140                        if interval.text == "":
1141                            continue
1142
1143                        # Before 1.0: check if there is a duration to use here.
1144                        # and maybe make this more intelligent by selecting
1145                        # purposefully the last non-empty first and taking the
1146                        # duration?
1147                        word_dur = interval.dur
1148                        stimulus_onset = (
1149                            recording['MonoAudio'].go_signal)
1150                        acoustic_onset = interval.xmin - stimulus_onset
1151                        break
1152                    annotations['word_dur'] = word_dur
1153                else:
1154                    annotations['word_dur'] = -1.0
1155
1156                if acoustic_onset < 0 or annotations['selected_time'] < 0:
1157                    aai = -1.0
1158                else:
1159                    aai = acoustic_onset - annotations['selected_time']
1160                annotations['AAI'] = aai
1161
1162                first_sound_dur = -1.0
1163                first_sound = ""
1164                if 'segment' in recording.textgrid:
1165                    for interval in recording.textgrid['segment']:
1166                        if interval.text and interval.text != 'beep':
1167                            first_sound_dur = interval.dur
1168                            first_sound = interval.text
1169                            break
1170                annotations['first_sound_dur'] = first_sound_dur
1171                annotations['first_sound'] = first_sound
1172                if first_sound in vowels:
1173                    annotations['first_sound_type'] = 'V'
1174                else:
1175                    annotations['first_sound_type'] = 'C'
1176
1177                annotations['C1'] = recording.metadata.prompt[0]
1178                writer.writerow(annotations)
1179            _logger.info(
1180                "Wrote onset data in file %s.", filename)
1181

1246    def onpick(self, event):
1247        """
1248        Callback for handling time selection on events.
1249        """
1250        # TODO 0.23: swap None for -1 here and fix everything that breaks. this
1251        # will include zooming. probably a good idea to change the dict here
1252        # into a dataclass as well.
1253        if not event.xdata:
1254            self.current.annotations['selected_time'] = -1
1255            self.current.annotations['selection_index'] = -1
1256            self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'] = -1
1257            self.current.annotations['selected_frequency'] = -1
1258            self.update()
1259            return
1260
1261        subplot = 0
1262        for i, axes in enumerate(self.plot_controller.data_axes):
1263            if axes == event.inaxes:
1264                subplot = i + 1
1265                break
1266
1267        _logger.debug(
1268            "Inside onpick - subplot: %d, x=%f, y=%f",
1269            subplot, event.xdata, event.ydata)
1270
1271        audio = self.current.modalities['MonoAudio']
1272        if audio.go_signal is None:
1273            stimulus_onset = 0
1274        else:
1275            stimulus_onset = audio.go_signal
1276
1277        # TODO 0.24: Remove hardcoding of modality names?
1278        if 'RawUltrasound' in self.current.modalities:
1279            timevector = (
1280                self.current.modalities['RawUltrasound'].timevector)
1281            distances = np.abs(timevector - stimulus_onset - event.xdata)
1282            self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'] = np.argmin(
1283                distances)
1284            self.current.annotations['selected_time'] = event.xdata
1285        if 'MonoAudio' in self.current.modalities:
1286            timevector = (
1287                self.current.modalities['MonoAudio'].timevector)
1288            distances = np.abs(timevector - stimulus_onset - event.xdata)
1289            self.current.annotations['selection_index'] = np.argmin(distances)
1290            self.current.annotations['selected_time'] = event.xdata
1291
1292        subplot_names = list(self.gui_config.data_axes.keys())
1293        if subplot-1 < len(subplot_names):
1294            if "spectrogram" in subplot_names[subplot-1]:
1295                self.current.annotations['selected_frequency'] = event.ydata
1296        else:
1297            self.current.annotations['selected_frequency'] = -1
1298
1299        _logger.debug(
1300            "Inside onpick - subplot: %d, ultra_index=%d, audio_index=%d, x=%f",
1301            subplot,
1302            self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'],
1303            self.current.annotations['selection_index'],
1304            self.current.annotations['selected_time'])
1305
1306        # Update the main canvas fast-path lines
1307        self.plot_controller.update_selection_cursors(self.current)
1308
1309        # If the ultrasound panel is open, update the requested frame
1310        if self.display_tongue:
1311            if self.image_type == GuiImageType.RAW_FRAME:
1312                has_ultra = self.plot_controller.draw_raw_ultra_frame(
1313                    self.current, self.image_type
1314                )
1315            else:
1316                has_ultra = self.plot_controller.draw_ultra_frame(
1317                    self.current, self.image_type
1318                )
1319
1320            # Since we bypassed self.update(), update the UI button locally
1321            self.action_export_ultrasound_frame.setEnabled(has_ultra)
1322
1323    def resize_event(self, event):
1324        """
1325        Window resize callback.
1326        """
1327        self.update()
1328        QMainWindow.resizeEvent(self, event)
1329
1330    # noinspection PyPep8Naming
1331    def keyPressEvent(self, event):
1332        """
1333        Key press callback.
1334
1335        QtPy is silly and wants the callback to have this specific name.
1336        """
1337        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Shift:
1338            self.shift_is_held = True
1339        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Control:
1340            self.ctrl_is_held = True
1341        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Alt:
1342            self.alt_is_held = True
1343        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_AltGr:
1344            self.alt_gr_is_held = True
1345
1346        if self.alt_is_held or self.alt_gr_is_held:
1347            if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_I:
1348                self.zoom_in()
1349            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_O:
1350                self.zoom_out()
1351            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_A:
1352                self.gui_config.auto_xlim = True
1353                self.gui_config.xlim = None
1354                self.update()
1355            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_C:
1356                self.center_on_cursor()
1357            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Left:
1358                self.pan(left=True)
1359            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Right:
1360                self.pan(left=False)
1361
1362    # noinspection PyPep8Naming
1363    def keyReleaseEvent(self, event):
1364        """
1365        Key release callback.
1366
1367        QtPy is silly and wants the callback to have this specific name.
1368        """
1369        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Shift:
1370            self.shift_is_held = False
1371        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Control:
1372            self.ctrl_is_held = False
1373        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Alt:
1374            self.alt_is_held = False
1375        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_AltGr:
1376            self.alt_gr_is_held = False
1377
1378    def on_color_scheme_changed(self, scheme: Qt.ColorScheme):
1379        """
1380        Call back to change from light to dark/vice versa with the system.
1381        """
1382        if scheme == Qt.ColorScheme.Light:
1383            self.change_to_light()
1384        else:
1385            self.change_to_dark()
1386
1387    def zoom_in(self) -> None:
1388        """
1389        Zoom in to half the current viewed length in time.
1390
1391        Will center on current cursor if there is a selection, otherwise will
1392        center on the current view.
1393        """
1394        self.gui_config.auto_xlim = False
1395        if self.current.annotations['selection_index'] >= 0:
1396            center = self.current.annotations['selected_time']
1397        elif self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'] >= 0:
1398            center = self.current.annotations['selected_time']
1399        else:
1400            center = (self.xlim[0] + self.xlim[1]) / 2.0
1401        length = (self.xlim[1] - self.xlim[0]) * .25
1402        self.xlim = (center - length, center + length)
1403        if self.gui_config.xlim is not None:
1404            self.gui_config.xlim = self.xlim
1405        self.update()
1406
1407    def zoom_out(self) -> None:
1408        """
1409        Zoom out to twice the current viewed length in time.
1410
1411        Will center on current cursor if there is a selection, otherwise will
1412        center on the current view.
1413        """
1414        self.gui_config.auto_xlim = False
1415        center = (self.xlim[0] + self.xlim[1]) / 2.0
1416        length = self.xlim[1] - self.xlim[0]
1417        self.xlim = (center - length, center + length)
1418        if self.gui_config.xlim is not None:
1419            self.gui_config.xlim = self.xlim
1420        self.update()
1421
1422    def pan(self, left: bool) -> None:
1423        """
1424        Pan left or right as instructed.
1425
1426        Parameters
1427        ----------
1428        left : bool
1429            Pan left if True, right if False.
1430        """
1431        self.gui_config.auto_xlim = False
1432        quarter_length = (self.xlim[1] - self.xlim[0])/4
1433        if left:
1434            self.xlim = (
1435                self.xlim[0] - quarter_length,
1436                self.xlim[1] - quarter_length
1437            )
1438        else:
1439            self.xlim = (
1440                self.xlim[0] + quarter_length,
1441                self.xlim[1] + quarter_length
1442            )
1443
1444        if self.gui_config.xlim is not None:
1445            self.gui_config.xlim = self.xlim
1446        self.update()
1447
1448    def center_on_cursor(self) -> None:
1449        """
1450        Center main graph on selection cursor at the current zoom level.
1451        """
1452        self.gui_config.auto_xlim = False
1453        center = self.current.annotations['selected_time']
1454        half_length = (self.xlim[1] - self.xlim[0]) / 2.0
1455        self.xlim = (center - half_length, center + half_length)
1456        if self.gui_config.xlim is not None:
1457            self.gui_config.xlim = self.xlim
1458        self.update()
1459
1460    @property
1461    def no_modifiers(self) -> bool:
1462        """
1463        True if no modifier keys are currently held down.
1464
1465        Returns
1466        -------
1467        bool
1468            True if no modifier keys are currently held down.
1469        """
1470        modifiers_pressed = (
1471            self.shift_is_held or
1472            self.ctrl_is_held or
1473            self.alt_is_held or
1474            self.alt_gr_is_held
1475        )
1476        return not modifiers_pressed
1477

1479def run_annotator(
1480        session: Session,
1481        config: Configuration,
1482) -> None:
1483    """
1484    Start the Annotator GUI.
1485
1486    Parameters
1487    ----------
1488    session : Session
1489        The Session to run the Annotator on.
1490    config : config.Configuration
1491        Configuration mainly for the GUI, but passing the complete
1492        Configuration, because other things are occasionally needed.
1493    """
1494    app = QtWidgets.QApplication(sys.argv)
1495    # Apparently the assignment to an unused variable is needed
1496    # to avoid a segfault.
1497    app.annotator = PdQtAnnotator(
1498        session=session,
1499        display_tongue=True,
1500        config=config)
1501    QCoreApplication.setApplicationName("PATKIT")
1502    sys.exit(app.exec())

 301    def _update_color_mode(self) -> None:
 302        match self.gui_config.color_scheme:
 303            case GuiColorScheme.DARK:
 304                self.change_to_dark()
 305            case GuiColorScheme.LIGHT:
 306                self.change_to_light()
 307            case GuiColorScheme.FOLLOW_SYSTEM:
 308                match QGuiApplication.styleHints().colorScheme():
 309                    case Qt.ColorScheme.Dark:
 310                        self.gui_config.color_scheme = GuiColorScheme.DARK
 311                        self.change_to_dark()
 312                    case Qt.ColorScheme.Light:
 313                        self.gui_config.color_scheme = GuiColorScheme.LIGHT
 314                        self.change_to_light()
 315                    case _:
 316                        self.gui_config.color_scheme = GuiColorScheme.DARK
 317                        self.change_to_dark()
 318                        _logger.warning(
 319                            "Unknown system level color scheme. "
 320                            "So just setting mode to dark.")
 321            case _:
 322                _logger.warning(
 323                    "Unrecognised gui style %s.",
 324                    self.gui_config.color_scheme)
 325
 326    def _update_exercise_controls(self):
 327        if self.session.exercise is None:
 328            self.action_new_exercise.setEnabled(True)
 329            self.mode_drop_down.setCurrentText(AnnotatorMode.ANALYSE.value)
 330            self.mode_drop_down.setEnabled(False)
 331            self.action_new_answer.setEnabled(False)
 332            self.action_open_answer.setEnabled(False)
 333            self.action_show_example.setEnabled(False)
 334        else:
 335            self.action_new_exercise.setEnabled(False)
 336            self.mode_drop_down.setCurrentText(self.annotator_mode.value)
 337            self.mode_drop_down.setEnabled(True)
 338            self.action_new_answer.setEnabled(True)
 339            self.action_open_answer.setEnabled(True)
 340            self.action_show_example.setEnabled(True)
 341

 345        mpl_style(dark=True)
 346        self.plot_controller.to_annotator_mode(

 352        mpl_style(dark=False)

 356    @property
 357    def current(self):
 358        """Current recording at index."""
 359        return self.recordings[self.index]
 360
 361    @property
 362    def default_annotations(self):
 363        """List default annotations and their default values as a dict."""
 364        return {
 365            'pdCategory': self.categories[-1],
 366            'tonguePosition': self.tongue_positions[-1],
 367            'selected_time': -1.0,
 368            'selection_index': -1,
 369            'frame_selection_index': -1,
 370            'selected_frequency': -1,
 371        }
 372
 373    def _add_annotations(self):
 374        """Add the annotations."""
 375        for recording in self.recordings:
 376            if recording.annotations:
 377                recording.annotations = dict(
 378                    list(self.default_annotations.items()) +
 379                    list(recording.annotations.items()))
 380            else:
 381                recording.annotations = deepcopy(self.default_annotations)
 382
 383    def _get_title(self):
 384        """
 385        Private helper function for generating the title.
 386        """
 387        text = 'Recording: ' + str(self.index + 1) + '/' + str(self.max_index)
 388        text += ', prompt: ' + self.current.metadata.prompt
 389        return text
 390
 391    def _get_long_title(self):
 392        """
 393        Private helper function for generating a longer title for a figure.
 394        """
 395        text = ""
 396        if (
 397            self.session.exercise is not None and
 398            self.exercise_drop_down.isEnabled()
 399        ):
 400            text += "Exercise Mode -- "
 401            text += "Answer: " + self.session.exercise.current_answer.name
 402            text += " -- Showing " + self.exercise_drop_down.currentText()
 403            text += ' -- '
 404
 405        text += 'Recording: ' + str(self.index + 1) + '/' + str(self.max_index)
 406        if str(self.current.metadata.participant_id):
 407            text += ', Speaker: ' + str(self.current.metadata.participant_id)
 408        if self.current.metadata.prompt:
 409            text += ', prompt: ' + self.current.metadata.prompt
 410        return text
 411
 412    def _release_modality_memory(self):
 413        if 'RawUltrasound' in self.current.modalities:
 414            self.current.modalities['RawUltrasound'].data = None
 415
 416    def _set_audio_for_player(self) -> None:
 417        """Pass the current audio data to the audio player."""
 418        if 'MonoAudio' in self.current.modalities:
 419            mono_audio = self.current['MonoAudio'].modality_data
 420            self.audio_player.set_audio(
 421                audio_data=mono_audio.data,
 422                sampling_rate=mono_audio.sampling_rate
 423            )
 424
 425    def _sync_selected_time(self, current_position: float) -> None:
 426        """
 427        Sync the global annotation state with the audio player's position.
 428
 429        Parameters
 430        ----------
 431        current_position : float
 432            The time in seconds where playback was paused.
 433        """
 434        self.current.annotations['selected_time'] = current_position
 435        self.update()
 436
 437    def update(self) -> None:
 438        """Updates the graphs but not the buttons."""
 439        if (
 440            self.annotator_mode is AnnotatorMode.EXERCISE and
 441            self.exercise_mode is ExerciseMode.ANSWER
 442        ):
 443            self.patgrid = self.session.exercise.current_answer[self.index]
 444        else:
 445            self.patgrid = self.current.patgrid
 446
 447        self.plot_controller.draw_plots(
 448            recording=self.current,
 449            patgrid=self.patgrid,
 450            xlim=self.xlim,
 451            mode=self.annotator_mode,
 452            exercise_mode=self.exercise_mode,
 453            title=self._get_long_title(),
 454        )
 455        self.plot_controller.update_multicursor()
 456        self.plot_controller.canvas.draw_idle()
 457
 458        if self.display_tongue:
 459            _logger.debug("Drawing ultra frame in update")
 460            has_ultra_data = self.plot_controller.draw_ultra_frame(
 461                recording=self.current,
 462                image_type=self.image_type
 463            )
 464            self.plot_controller.ultra_canvas.draw_idle()
 465            self.action_export_ultrasound_frame.setEnabled(has_ultra_data)

 467    def update_ui(self):

 495    def next(self):
 496        """
 497        Callback function for the Next button.
 498        Increases cursor index, updates the view.
 499        """
 500        if self.index < self.max_index - 1:
 501            self._release_modality_memory()
 502            self.index += 1

 504            self.update()
 505            self.update_ui()
 506            if self.session.exercise is not None:
 507                self.session.exercise.current_answer.next()

 509    def prev(self):
 510        """
 511        Callback function for the Previous button.
 512        Decreases cursor index, updates the view.
 513        """
 514        if self.index > 0:
 515            self._release_modality_memory()
 516            self.index -= 1
 517            self._set_audio_for_player()
 518            self.update()
 519            self.update_ui()
 520            if self.session.exercise is not None:
 521                self.session.exercise.current_answer.previous()

 549    def _update_pd_onset(self):
 550        audio = self.current.modalities['MonoAudio']
 551        if audio.go_signal is None:
 552            stimulus_onset = 0
 553        else:
 554            stimulus_onset = audio.go_signal
 555
 556        # TODO 0.24: This should not be hard coded
 557        if 'PD l1 on RawUltrasound' in self.current.modalities:
 558            pd_metrics = self.current.modalities['PD l1 on RawUltrasound']
 559            ultra_time = pd_metrics.timevector - stimulus_onset
 560            index = self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index']
 561            self.current.annotations['selected_time'] = ultra_time[index]
 562
 563    def next_frame(self):
 564        """
 565        Move the data cursor to the next frame.
 566        """
 567        # TODO 0.24: Remove hard coding again
 568        if 'PD l1 on RawUltrasound' not in self.current.modalities:
 569            return
 570
 571        frame_selection_index = self.current.annotations[
 572            'frame_selection_index']
 573        pd = self.current.modalities['PD l1 on RawUltrasound']
 574        data_length = pd.data.size
 575        if -1 < frame_selection_index < data_length:
 576            self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'] += 1
 577            _logger.debug(
 578                "next frame: %d",
 579                (self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index']))
 580            self._update_pd_onset()
 581            self.update()
 582            self.update_ui()
 583
 584    def previous_frame(self):
 585        """
 586        Move the data cursor to the previous frame.
 587        """
 588        if self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'] > 0:
 589            self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'] -= 1
 590            _logger.debug(
 591                "previous frame: %d",
 592                (self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index']))
 593            self._update_pd_onset()
 594            self.update()
 595            self.update_ui()
 596

 603            new_cursor = self.current['MonoAudio'].modality_data.timevector[0]
 604            self.current.annotations['selected_time'] = new_cursor

 630    def open(self):
 631        """
 632        Open either patkit saved data or import new data.
 633        """
 634        directory_name = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
 635            self, caption="Open directory", directory='.'
 636        )
 637        if not directory_name:
 638            return  # User cancelled the dialog
 639
 640        target_path = Path(directory_name)
 641
 642        # TODO 0.24: this should be made into a proper option, now it's just
 643        # set at in run_annotator below
 644        # self.display_tongue = display_tongue
 645
 646        path_type, target_path = resolve_open_path(target_path)
 647
 648        match path_type:
 649            case OpenPathType.MANIFEST:
 650                scenarios = get_manifest_scenarios(path=target_path)
 651                if not scenarios:
 652                    raise ValueError("Manifest file is empty or invalid.")
 653                elif len(scenarios) == 1:
 654                    target_path = scenarios[0]
 655                else:
 656                    # Prompt the user to choose if multiple exist
 657                    scenario_strings = [str(p) for p in scenarios]
 658                    chosen_string, ok_pressed = ListSelectionDialog.get_item(
 659                        parent=self,
 660                        title="Select Scenario",
 661                        label="Multiple scenarios found. Select one:",
 662                        items=scenario_strings,
 663                        current=0,
 664                    )
 665                    if ok_pressed and chosen_string:
 666                        target_path = Path(chosen_string)
 667                    else:
 668                        return  # User cancelled the prompt
 669            case OpenPathType.SCENARIO:
 670                pass
 671            case OpenPathType.DIRECTORY:
 672                raise NotImplementedError(
 673                    "Opening a directory of data without "
 674                    "config is not implemented yet."
 675                )
 676            case OpenPathType.SINGLE_DATA:
 677                raise NotImplementedError(
 678                    "Opening a single data file without "
 679                    "config is not implemented yet."
 680                )
 681            case _:
 682                raise NotImplementedError(
 683                    f"Unknown path type {path_type}."
 684                )
 685
 686        # Read config and data
 687        config, logger = initialise_config(
 688            path=target_path, require_gui=True
 689        )
 690        self.session = initialise_patkit(config=config, logger=logger)
 691
 692        # Re-bind Configuration Properties
 693        self.config = config  # Update the annotator's config reference
 694        self.data_config = config.data_config
 695        self.gui_config = config.gui_config
 696        self.gui_color_mode = self.gui_config.color_scheme
 697        self._update_color_mode()
 698
 699        # Reset Core State Variables
 700        self.recordings = self.session.recordings
 701        self.index = 0
 702        self.max_index = len(self.recordings)
 703        self.patgrid = self.current.patgrid  # self.current uses self.index
 704
 705        # Update Validators and Database View
 706        go_validator = QIntValidator(1, self.max_index + 1, self)
 707        self.go_to_line_edit.setValidator(go_validator)
 708        self.replace_items_in_database_view(session=self.session)
 709        self._add_annotations()
 710
 711        self.update()
 712        # In case labels change as new plots are drawn.
 713        self.figure.align_ylabels()
 714        self.update_ui()
 715

 780    def new_exercise(self) -> bool:
 781        """Create a new exercise based on the current Session."""
 782        scrambling_method = NewExerciseDialog.get_exercise_params(
 783            parent=self,
 784            path=self.session.patkit_path)
 785        if scrambling_method is None:
 786            return False
 787
 788        file_info = FileInformation(
 789            patkit_path=self.session.patkit_path / PatkitDirectory.EXERCISE
 790        )
 791        metadata = ExerciseMetadata(
 792            scrambling_method=ExerciseScrambler(scrambling_method),
 793        )
 794        self.session.exercise = Exercise(
 795            scenario=self.session,
 796            name=str(PatkitDirectory.EXERCISE),
 797            metadata=metadata,
 798            file_info=file_info,
 799        )
 800        if not self.new_answer():
 801            self.session.exercise = None
 802            return False
 803
 804        self.save_exercise()
 805        self.annotator_mode = AnnotatorMode.EXERCISE
 806        self._update_exercise_controls()
 807        return True
 808

 813    def new_answer(self) -> bool:
 814        """Create a new blank answer for the current exercise."""
 815        answer_name, author_name = NewAnswerDialog.get_answer_params(self)
 816        if answer_name is None:
 817            return False
 818
 819        self.session.exercise.new_blank_answer(
 820            name=answer_name, author=author_name)
 821
 822        # Move cursor to newly generated answer (always at the end)
 823        self.session.exercise.cursor = len(self.session.exercise) - 1
 824        self.save_answer()
 825
 826        self.annotator_mode = AnnotatorMode.EXERCISE
 827        self._update_exercise_controls()
 828        self.update()
 829        return True

 835    def open_answer(self) -> None:
 836        """Load an Answer and open it in the GUI."""
 837        answers_dir = (
 838            self.session.exercise.patkit_path / PatkitDirectory.ANSWERS
 839        )
 840
 841        available_answers = [
 842            d.name for d in answers_dir.iterdir() if d.is_dir()
 843        ]
 844        available_answers.sort()
 845
 846        answer_name, ok = QInputDialog.getItem(
 847            self,
 848            "Open Answer",
 849            "Select answer to open:",
 850            available_answers,
 851            0,
 852            False
 853        )
 854
 855        if not ok or not answer_name:
 856            return
 857
 858        # TODO 0.22.3: The loading here might be redundant, if Exercise already
 859        # front loads every answer.
 860        directory = answers_dir / answer_name
 861        answer = load_answer(
 862            answer_dir=directory, exercise=self.session.exercise
 863        )
 864        self.session.exercise[answer.name] = answer
 865
 866        self.session.exercise.cursor = list(
 867            self.session.exercise.keys()).index(answer.name)
 868        self.annotator_mode = AnnotatorMode.EXERCISE
 869        self._update_exercise_controls()
 870        self.go_to_recording(self.session.exercise.current_answer.cursor)
 871

 934    def mode_selection_changed(self, mode: str) -> None:
 935        """
 936        Callback for changing annotator mode.
 937
 938        Parameters
 939        ----------
 940        mode : str
 941            The mode's name as a string.
 942
 943        Raises
 944        ------
 945        ValueError
 946            If encountering an unimplemented mode an Error will be raised.
 947        """
 948        self.annotator_mode = AnnotatorMode(mode)
 949        match self.annotator_mode:
 950            case AnnotatorMode.ANALYSE:
 951                self.to_annotator_mode()
 952            case AnnotatorMode.EXERCISE:
 953                self.to_exercise_mode()
 954            case _:
 955                raise ValueError(f"Unknown Annotator Mode requested: {mode}.")
 956

 964            The mode's name as a string.
 965
 966        Raises
 967        ------
 968        ValueError
 969            If encountering an unimplemented mode an Error will be raised.
 970        """
 971        self.exercise_mode = ExerciseMode(mode)
 972        match self.exercise_mode:
 973            case ExerciseMode.EXAMPLE:

1063                if ultrasound in recording
1064            )
1065            interpolation_params = ultrasound_modality.interpolation_params
1066        else:
1067            interpolation_params = None
1068
1069        for image in image_list:
1070            export_aggregate_image_and_meta(
1071                image=self.current.statistics[image],
1072                session=self.session,
1073                recording=self.current,
1074                path=path,

1102    def export_annotations_and_metadata(self) -> None:
1103        """
1104        Export annotations and some other meta data.
1105        """
1106        (filename, _) = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
1107            self, 'Save file', directory='.', filter="CSV files (*.csv)")
1108
1109        if not filename:
1110            return
1111
1112        vowels = ['a', 'A', 'e', 'E', 'i', 'I',
1113                  'o', 'O', 'u', '@', "@`", 'OI', 'V']
1114        fieldnames = ['basename', 'date_and_time', 'prompt', 'C1', 'C1_dur',
1115                      'word_dur', 'first_sound',
1116                      'first_sound_type', 'first_sound_dur', 'AAI']
1117        fieldnames.extend(self.default_annotations.keys())
1118        csv.register_dialect('tabseparated', delimiter='\t',
1119                             quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONE)
1120
1121        with closing(open(filename, 'w', encoding='utf-8')) as csvfile:
1122            writer = csv.DictWriter(csvfile, fieldnames, extrasaction='ignore',
1123                                    dialect='tabseparated')
1124
1125            writer.writeheader()
1126            for recording in self.recordings:
1127                annotations = recording.annotations.copy()
1128                annotations['basename'] = recording.basename
1129                annotations['date_and_time'] = (
1130                    recording.metadata.time_of_recording)
1131                annotations['prompt'] = recording.metadata.prompt
1132                annotations['word'] = recording.metadata.prompt.split()[0]
1133
1134                word_dur = -1.0
1135                acoustic_onset = -1.0
1136                if 'word' in recording.textgrid:
1137                    for interval in recording.textgrid['word']:
1138                        # change this to access the phonemeDict and
1139                        # check for included words, then search for
1140                        # phonemes based on the same
1141                        if interval.text == "":
1142                            continue
1143
1144                        # Before 1.0: check if there is a duration to use here.
1145                        # and maybe make this more intelligent by selecting
1146                        # purposefully the last non-empty first and taking the
1147                        # duration?
1148                        word_dur = interval.dur
1149                        stimulus_onset = (
1150                            recording['MonoAudio'].go_signal)
1151                        acoustic_onset = interval.xmin - stimulus_onset
1152                        break
1153                    annotations['word_dur'] = word_dur
1154                else:
1155                    annotations['word_dur'] = -1.0
1156
1157                if acoustic_onset < 0 or annotations['selected_time'] < 0:
1158                    aai = -1.0
1159                else:
1160                    aai = acoustic_onset - annotations['selected_time']
1161                annotations['AAI'] = aai
1162
1163                first_sound_dur = -1.0
1164                first_sound = ""
1165                if 'segment' in recording.textgrid:
1166                    for interval in recording.textgrid['segment']:
1167                        if interval.text and interval.text != 'beep':
1168                            first_sound_dur = interval.dur
1169                            first_sound = interval.text
1170                            break
1171                annotations['first_sound_dur'] = first_sound_dur
1172                annotations['first_sound'] = first_sound
1173                if first_sound in vowels:
1174                    annotations['first_sound_type'] = 'V'
1175                else:
1176                    annotations['first_sound_type'] = 'C'
1177
1178                annotations['C1'] = recording.metadata.prompt[0]
1179                writer.writerow(annotations)
1180            _logger.info(
1181                "Wrote onset data in file %s.", filename)

1247    def onpick(self, event):
1248        """
1249        Callback for handling time selection on events.
1250        """
1251        # TODO 0.23: swap None for -1 here and fix everything that breaks. this
1252        # will include zooming. probably a good idea to change the dict here
1253        # into a dataclass as well.
1254        if not event.xdata:
1255            self.current.annotations['selected_time'] = -1
1256            self.current.annotations['selection_index'] = -1
1257            self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'] = -1
1258            self.current.annotations['selected_frequency'] = -1
1259            self.update()
1260            return
1261
1262        subplot = 0
1263        for i, axes in enumerate(self.plot_controller.data_axes):
1264            if axes == event.inaxes:
1265                subplot = i + 1
1266                break
1267
1268        _logger.debug(
1269            "Inside onpick - subplot: %d, x=%f, y=%f",
1270            subplot, event.xdata, event.ydata)
1271
1272        audio = self.current.modalities['MonoAudio']
1273        if audio.go_signal is None:
1274            stimulus_onset = 0
1275        else:
1276            stimulus_onset = audio.go_signal
1277
1278        # TODO 0.24: Remove hardcoding of modality names?
1279        if 'RawUltrasound' in self.current.modalities:
1280            timevector = (
1281                self.current.modalities['RawUltrasound'].timevector)
1282            distances = np.abs(timevector - stimulus_onset - event.xdata)
1283            self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'] = np.argmin(
1284                distances)
1285            self.current.annotations['selected_time'] = event.xdata
1286        if 'MonoAudio' in self.current.modalities:
1287            timevector = (
1288                self.current.modalities['MonoAudio'].timevector)
1289            distances = np.abs(timevector - stimulus_onset - event.xdata)
1290            self.current.annotations['selection_index'] = np.argmin(distances)
1291            self.current.annotations['selected_time'] = event.xdata
1292
1293        subplot_names = list(self.gui_config.data_axes.keys())
1294        if subplot-1 < len(subplot_names):
1295            if "spectrogram" in subplot_names[subplot-1]:
1296                self.current.annotations['selected_frequency'] = event.ydata
1297        else:
1298            self.current.annotations['selected_frequency'] = -1
1299
1300        _logger.debug(
1301            "Inside onpick - subplot: %d, ultra_index=%d, audio_index=%d, x=%f",
1302            subplot,
1303            self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'],
1304            self.current.annotations['selection_index'],
1305            self.current.annotations['selected_time'])
1306
1307        # Update the main canvas fast-path lines
1308        self.plot_controller.update_selection_cursors(self.current)
1309
1310        # If the ultrasound panel is open, update the requested frame
1311        if self.display_tongue:
1312            if self.image_type == GuiImageType.RAW_FRAME:
1313                has_ultra = self.plot_controller.draw_raw_ultra_frame(
1314                    self.current, self.image_type
1315                )
1316            else:
1317                has_ultra = self.plot_controller.draw_ultra_frame(
1318                    self.current, self.image_type
1319                )
1320
1321            # Since we bypassed self.update(), update the UI button locally
1322            self.action_export_ultrasound_frame.setEnabled(has_ultra)
1323

1329        QMainWindow.resizeEvent(self, event)

1331    # noinspection PyPep8Naming
1332    def keyPressEvent(self, event):
1333        """
1334        Key press callback.
1335
1336        QtPy is silly and wants the callback to have this specific name.
1337        """
1338        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Shift:
1339            self.shift_is_held = True
1340        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Control:
1341            self.ctrl_is_held = True
1342        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Alt:
1343            self.alt_is_held = True
1344        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_AltGr:
1345            self.alt_gr_is_held = True
1346
1347        if self.alt_is_held or self.alt_gr_is_held:
1348            if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_I:
1349                self.zoom_in()
1350            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_O:
1351                self.zoom_out()
1352            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_A:
1353                self.gui_config.auto_xlim = True
1354                self.gui_config.xlim = None
1355                self.update()
1356            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_C:
1357                self.center_on_cursor()
1358            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Left:
1359                self.pan(left=True)
1360            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Right:
1361                self.pan(left=False)
1362
1363    # noinspection PyPep8Naming
1364    def keyReleaseEvent(self, event):
1365        """
1366        Key release callback.
1367
1368        QtPy is silly and wants the callback to have this specific name.
1369        """
1370        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Shift:
1371            self.shift_is_held = False
1372        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Control:
1373            self.ctrl_is_held = False
1374        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Alt:
1375            self.alt_is_held = False
1376        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_AltGr:
1377            self.alt_gr_is_held = False
1378
1379    def on_color_scheme_changed(self, scheme: Qt.ColorScheme):

1384            self.change_to_light()
1385        else:
1386            self.change_to_dark()

1388    def zoom_in(self) -> None:
1389        """
1390        Zoom in to half the current viewed length in time.
1391
1392        Will center on current cursor if there is a selection, otherwise will
1393        center on the current view.
1394        """
1395        self.gui_config.auto_xlim = False
1396        if self.current.annotations['selection_index'] >= 0:
1397            center = self.current.annotations['selected_time']
1398        elif self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'] >= 0:
1399            center = self.current.annotations['selected_time']
1400        else:
1401            center = (self.xlim[0] + self.xlim[1]) / 2.0
1402        length = (self.xlim[1] - self.xlim[0]) * .25
1403        self.xlim = (center - length, center + length)
1404        if self.gui_config.xlim is not None:
1405            self.gui_config.xlim = self.xlim
1406        self.update()
1407
1408    def zoom_out(self) -> None:
1409        """
1410        Zoom out to twice the current viewed length in time.
1411
1412        Will center on current cursor if there is a selection, otherwise will
1413        center on the current view.
1414        """
1415        self.gui_config.auto_xlim = False
1416        center = (self.xlim[0] + self.xlim[1]) / 2.0
1417        length = self.xlim[1] - self.xlim[0]
1418        self.xlim = (center - length, center + length)
1419        if self.gui_config.xlim is not None:
1420            self.gui_config.xlim = self.xlim
1421        self.update()
1422
1423    def pan(self, left: bool) -> None:
1424        """
1425        Pan left or right as instructed.
1426
1427        Parameters
1428        ----------
1429        left : bool
1430            Pan left if True, right if False.
1431        """
1432        self.gui_config.auto_xlim = False
1433        quarter_length = (self.xlim[1] - self.xlim[0])/4
1434        if left:
1435            self.xlim = (
1436                self.xlim[0] - quarter_length,
1437                self.xlim[1] - quarter_length
1438            )
1439        else:
1440            self.xlim = (
1441                self.xlim[0] + quarter_length,
1442                self.xlim[1] + quarter_length
1443            )
1444
1445        if self.gui_config.xlim is not None:
1446            self.gui_config.xlim = self.xlim
1447        self.update()
1448
1449    def center_on_cursor(self) -> None:
1450        """
1451        Center main graph on selection cursor at the current zoom level.
1452        """
1453        self.gui_config.auto_xlim = False
1454        center = self.current.annotations['selected_time']
1455        half_length = (self.xlim[1] - self.xlim[0]) / 2.0
1456        self.xlim = (center - half_length, center + half_length)
1457        if self.gui_config.xlim is not None:
1458            self.gui_config.xlim = self.xlim
1459        self.update()
1460
1461    @property
1462    def no_modifiers(self) -> bool:
1463        """
1464        True if no modifier keys are currently held down.
1465
1466        Returns
1467        -------
1468        bool
1469            True if no modifier keys are currently held down.
1470        """
1471        modifiers_pressed = (
1472            self.shift_is_held or
1473            self.ctrl_is_held or
1474            self.alt_is_held or
1475            self.alt_gr_is_held
1476        )
1477        return not modifiers_pressed

Qt_Annotator_Window is a GUI class for annotating PD curves.

The annotator works with PD curves and allows selection of a single points (labelled as pdOnset in the saved file). The GUI also displays the waveform, and if TextGrids are provided, the acoustic segment boundaries.

def update(self) -> None: 
437    def update(self) -> None:
438        """Updates the graphs but not the buttons."""
439        if (
440            self.annotator_mode is AnnotatorMode.EXERCISE and
441            self.exercise_mode is ExerciseMode.ANSWER
442        ):
443            self.patgrid = self.session.exercise.current_answer[self.index]
444        else:
445            self.patgrid = self.current.patgrid
446
447        self.plot_controller.draw_plots(
448            recording=self.current,
449            patgrid=self.patgrid,
450            xlim=self.xlim,
451            mode=self.annotator_mode,
452            exercise_mode=self.exercise_mode,
453            title=self._get_long_title(),
454        )
455        self.plot_controller.update_multicursor()
456        self.plot_controller.canvas.draw_idle()
457
458        if self.display_tongue:
459            _logger.debug("Drawing ultra frame in update")
460            has_ultra_data = self.plot_controller.draw_ultra_frame(
461                recording=self.current,
462                image_type=self.image_type
463            )
464            self.plot_controller.ultra_canvas.draw_idle()
465            self.action_export_ultrasound_frame.setEnabled(has_ultra_data)

def open(self): 
630    def open(self):
631        """
632        Open either patkit saved data or import new data.
633        """
634        directory_name = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
635            self, caption="Open directory", directory='.'
636        )
637        if not directory_name:
638            return  # User cancelled the dialog
639
640        target_path = Path(directory_name)
641
642        # TODO 0.24: this should be made into a proper option, now it's just
643        # set at in run_annotator below
644        # self.display_tongue = display_tongue
645
646        path_type, target_path = resolve_open_path(target_path)
647
648        match path_type:
649            case OpenPathType.MANIFEST:
650                scenarios = get_manifest_scenarios(path=target_path)
651                if not scenarios:
652                    raise ValueError("Manifest file is empty or invalid.")
653                elif len(scenarios) == 1:
654                    target_path = scenarios[0]
655                else:
656                    # Prompt the user to choose if multiple exist
657                    scenario_strings = [str(p) for p in scenarios]
658                    chosen_string, ok_pressed = ListSelectionDialog.get_item(
659                        parent=self,
660                        title="Select Scenario",
661                        label="Multiple scenarios found. Select one:",
662                        items=scenario_strings,
663                        current=0,
664                    )
665                    if ok_pressed and chosen_string:
666                        target_path = Path(chosen_string)
667                    else:
668                        return  # User cancelled the prompt
669            case OpenPathType.SCENARIO:
670                pass
671            case OpenPathType.DIRECTORY:
672                raise NotImplementedError(
673                    "Opening a directory of data without "
674                    "config is not implemented yet."
675                )
676            case OpenPathType.SINGLE_DATA:
677                raise NotImplementedError(
678                    "Opening a single data file without "
679                    "config is not implemented yet."
680                )
681            case _:
682                raise NotImplementedError(
683                    f"Unknown path type {path_type}."
684                )
685
686        # Read config and data
687        config, logger = initialise_config(
688            path=target_path, require_gui=True
689        )
690        self.session = initialise_patkit(config=config, logger=logger)
691
692        # Re-bind Configuration Properties
693        self.config = config  # Update the annotator's config reference
694        self.data_config = config.data_config
695        self.gui_config = config.gui_config
696        self.gui_color_mode = self.gui_config.color_scheme
697        self._update_color_mode()
698
699        # Reset Core State Variables
700        self.recordings = self.session.recordings
701        self.index = 0
702        self.max_index = len(self.recordings)
703        self.patgrid = self.current.patgrid  # self.current uses self.index
704
705        # Update Validators and Database View
706        go_validator = QIntValidator(1, self.max_index + 1, self)
707        self.go_to_line_edit.setValidator(go_validator)
708        self.replace_items_in_database_view(session=self.session)
709        self._add_annotations()
710
711        self.update()
712        # In case labels change as new plots are drawn.
713        self.figure.align_ylabels()
714        self.update_ui()

Open either patkit saved data or import new data.

def new_exercise(self) -> bool: 
780    def new_exercise(self) -> bool:
781        """Create a new exercise based on the current Session."""
782        scrambling_method = NewExerciseDialog.get_exercise_params(
783            parent=self,
784            path=self.session.patkit_path)
785        if scrambling_method is None:
786            return False
787
788        file_info = FileInformation(
789            patkit_path=self.session.patkit_path / PatkitDirectory.EXERCISE
790        )
791        metadata = ExerciseMetadata(
792            scrambling_method=ExerciseScrambler(scrambling_method),
793        )
794        self.session.exercise = Exercise(
795            scenario=self.session,
796            name=str(PatkitDirectory.EXERCISE),
797            metadata=metadata,
798            file_info=file_info,
799        )
800        if not self.new_answer():
801            self.session.exercise = None
802            return False
803
804        self.save_exercise()
805        self.annotator_mode = AnnotatorMode.EXERCISE
806        self._update_exercise_controls()
807        return True

def open_answer(self) -> None: 
835    def open_answer(self) -> None:
836        """Load an Answer and open it in the GUI."""
837        answers_dir = (
838            self.session.exercise.patkit_path / PatkitDirectory.ANSWERS
839        )
840
841        available_answers = [
842            d.name for d in answers_dir.iterdir() if d.is_dir()
843        ]
844        available_answers.sort()
845
846        answer_name, ok = QInputDialog.getItem(
847            self,
848            "Open Answer",
849            "Select answer to open:",
850            available_answers,
851            0,
852            False
853        )
854
855        if not ok or not answer_name:
856            return
857
858        # TODO 0.22.3: The loading here might be redundant, if Exercise already
859        # front loads every answer.
860        directory = answers_dir / answer_name
861        answer = load_answer(
862            answer_dir=directory, exercise=self.session.exercise
863        )
864        self.session.exercise[answer.name] = answer
865
866        self.session.exercise.cursor = list(
867            self.session.exercise.keys()).index(answer.name)
868        self.annotator_mode = AnnotatorMode.EXERCISE
869        self._update_exercise_controls()
870        self.go_to_recording(self.session.exercise.current_answer.cursor)

1111
1112        vowels = ['a', 'A', 'e', 'E', 'i', 'I',
1113                  'o', 'O', 'u', '@', "@`", 'OI', 'V']
1114        fieldnames = ['basename', 'date_and_time', 'prompt', 'C1', 'C1_dur',
1115                      'word_dur', 'first_sound',
1116                      'first_sound_type', 'first_sound_dur', 'AAI']
1117        fieldnames.extend(self.default_annotations.keys())
1118        csv.register_dialect('tabseparated', delimiter='\t',
1119                             quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONE)
1120
1121        with closing(open(filename, 'w', encoding='utf-8')) as csvfile:
1122            writer = csv.DictWriter(csvfile, fieldnames, extrasaction='ignore',
1123                                    dialect='tabseparated')
1124
1125            writer.writeheader()
1126            for recording in self.recordings:
1127                annotations = recording.annotations.copy()
1128                annotations['basename'] = recording.basename
1129                annotations['date_and_time'] = (
1130                    recording.metadata.time_of_recording)
1131                annotations['prompt'] = recording.metadata.prompt
1132                annotations['word'] = recording.metadata.prompt.split()[0]
1133
1134                word_dur = -1.0
1135                acoustic_onset = -1.0
1136                if 'word' in recording.textgrid:
1137                    for interval in recording.textgrid['word']:
1138                        # change this to access the phonemeDict and
1139                        # check for included words, then search for
1140                        # phonemes based on the same
1141                        if interval.text == "":
1142                            continue
1143
1144                        # Before 1.0: check if there is a duration to use here.
1145                        # and maybe make this more intelligent by selecting
1146                        # purposefully the last non-empty first and taking the
1147                        # duration?
1148                        word_dur = interval.dur
1149                        stimulus_onset = (
1150                            recording['MonoAudio'].go_signal)
1151                        acoustic_onset = interval.xmin - stimulus_onset
1152                        break
1153                    annotations['word_dur'] = word_dur
1154                else:
1155                    annotations['word_dur'] = -1.0
1156
1157                if acoustic_onset < 0 or annotations['selected_time'] < 0:
1158                    aai = -1.0
1159                else:
1160                    aai = acoustic_onset - annotations['selected_time']
1161                annotations['AAI'] = aai
1162
1163                first_sound_dur = -1.0
1164                first_sound = ""
1165                if 'segment' in recording.textgrid:
1166                    for interval in recording.textgrid['segment']:
1167                        if interval.text and interval.text != 'beep':
1168                            first_sound_dur = interval.dur
1169                            first_sound = interval.text
1170                            break
1171                annotations['first_sound_dur'] = first_sound_dur
1172                annotations['first_sound'] = first_sound
1173                if first_sound in vowels:
1174                    annotations['first_sound_type'] = 'V'
1175                else:
1176                    annotations['first_sound_type'] = 'C'
1177
1178                annotations['C1'] = recording.metadata.prompt[0]
1179                writer.writerow(annotations)
1180            _logger.info(
1181                "Wrote onset data in file %s.", filename)

def onpick(self, event): 
1247    def onpick(self, event):
1248        """
1249        Callback for handling time selection on events.
1250        """
1251        # TODO 0.23: swap None for -1 here and fix everything that breaks. this
1252        # will include zooming. probably a good idea to change the dict here
1253        # into a dataclass as well.
1254        if not event.xdata:
1255            self.current.annotations['selected_time'] = -1
1256            self.current.annotations['selection_index'] = -1
1257            self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'] = -1
1258            self.current.annotations['selected_frequency'] = -1
1259            self.update()
1260            return
1261
1262        subplot = 0
1263        for i, axes in enumerate(self.plot_controller.data_axes):
1264            if axes == event.inaxes:
1265                subplot = i + 1
1266                break
1267
1268        _logger.debug(
1269            "Inside onpick - subplot: %d, x=%f, y=%f",
1270            subplot, event.xdata, event.ydata)
1271
1272        audio = self.current.modalities['MonoAudio']
1273        if audio.go_signal is None:
1274            stimulus_onset = 0
1275        else:
1276            stimulus_onset = audio.go_signal
1277
1278        # TODO 0.24: Remove hardcoding of modality names?
1279        if 'RawUltrasound' in self.current.modalities:
1280            timevector = (
1281                self.current.modalities['RawUltrasound'].timevector)
1282            distances = np.abs(timevector - stimulus_onset - event.xdata)
1283            self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'] = np.argmin(
1284                distances)
1285            self.current.annotations['selected_time'] = event.xdata
1286        if 'MonoAudio' in self.current.modalities:
1287            timevector = (
1288                self.current.modalities['MonoAudio'].timevector)
1289            distances = np.abs(timevector - stimulus_onset - event.xdata)
1290            self.current.annotations['selection_index'] = np.argmin(distances)
1291            self.current.annotations['selected_time'] = event.xdata
1292
1293        subplot_names = list(self.gui_config.data_axes.keys())
1294        if subplot-1 < len(subplot_names):
1295            if "spectrogram" in subplot_names[subplot-1]:
1296                self.current.annotations['selected_frequency'] = event.ydata
1297        else:
1298            self.current.annotations['selected_frequency'] = -1
1299
1300        _logger.debug(
1301            "Inside onpick - subplot: %d, ultra_index=%d, audio_index=%d, x=%f",
1302            subplot,
1303            self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'],
1304            self.current.annotations['selection_index'],
1305            self.current.annotations['selected_time'])
1306
1307        # Update the main canvas fast-path lines
1308        self.plot_controller.update_selection_cursors(self.current)
1309
1310        # If the ultrasound panel is open, update the requested frame
1311        if self.display_tongue:
1312            if self.image_type == GuiImageType.RAW_FRAME:
1313                has_ultra = self.plot_controller.draw_raw_ultra_frame(
1314                    self.current, self.image_type
1315                )
1316            else:
1317                has_ultra = self.plot_controller.draw_ultra_frame(
1318                    self.current, self.image_type
1319                )
1320
1321            # Since we bypassed self.update(), update the UI button locally
1322            self.action_export_ultrasound_frame.setEnabled(has_ultra)

def keyPressEvent(self, event): 
1332    def keyPressEvent(self, event):
1333        """
1334        Key press callback.
1335
1336        QtPy is silly and wants the callback to have this specific name.
1337        """
1338        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Shift:
1339            self.shift_is_held = True
1340        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Control:
1341            self.ctrl_is_held = True
1342        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Alt:
1343            self.alt_is_held = True
1344        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_AltGr:
1345            self.alt_gr_is_held = True
1346
1347        if self.alt_is_held or self.alt_gr_is_held:
1348            if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_I:
1349                self.zoom_in()
1350            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_O:
1351                self.zoom_out()
1352            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_A:
1353                self.gui_config.auto_xlim = True
1354                self.gui_config.xlim = None
1355                self.update()
1356            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_C:
1357                self.center_on_cursor()
1358            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Left:
1359                self.pan(left=True)
1360            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Right:
1361                self.pan(left=False)

def zoom_in(self) -> None: 
1388    def zoom_in(self) -> None:
1389        """
1390        Zoom in to half the current viewed length in time.
1391
1392        Will center on current cursor if there is a selection, otherwise will
1393        center on the current view.
1394        """
1395        self.gui_config.auto_xlim = False
1396        if self.current.annotations['selection_index'] >= 0:
1397            center = self.current.annotations['selected_time']
1398        elif self.current.annotations['frame_selection_index'] >= 0:
1399            center = self.current.annotations['selected_time']
1400        else:
1401            center = (self.xlim[0] + self.xlim[1]) / 2.0
1402        length = (self.xlim[1] - self.xlim[0]) * .25
1403        self.xlim = (center - length, center + length)
1404        if self.gui_config.xlim is not None:
1405            self.gui_config.xlim = self.xlim
1406        self.update()

def pan(self, left: bool) -> None: 
1423    def pan(self, left: bool) -> None:
1424        """
1425        Pan left or right as instructed.
1426
1427        Parameters
1428        ----------
1429        left : bool
1430            Pan left if True, right if False.
1431        """
1432        self.gui_config.auto_xlim = False
1433        quarter_length = (self.xlim[1] - self.xlim[0])/4
1434        if left:
1435            self.xlim = (
1436                self.xlim[0] - quarter_length,
1437                self.xlim[1] - quarter_length
1438            )
1439        else:
1440            self.xlim = (
1441                self.xlim[0] + quarter_length,
1442                self.xlim[1] + quarter_length
1443            )
1444
1445        if self.gui_config.xlim is not None:
1446            self.gui_config.xlim = self.xlim
1447        self.update()
